blocks.text: What Steps Need To Be Taken To Secure A Loan?
You’ll see some pictures in this video to help you remember later, but the first step in securing a loan is to complete a loan application.
To do so, you’ll need the following information.

items.text: Pay stubs for the past 2-3 months.
W-2 forms for the past 2 years.
Recent bank statements tax returns for the past 2 years.
Address and description of the property you wish to buy.
A sales contract on the home you want to buy.

blocks.text: During the application process, the lender will order a report on your credit history and a professional appraisal of the property you want to purchase. The application process typically takes between 1-6 weeks.
